data.text:
Jack, I’ll commit to 15 tons this month and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided Kate and Emma make the same commitment and Luke takes zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, but looking after our neighbors matters too.

I also agree to the recovery limit: 6 tons each next month, no more than 30 combined. Once the lake returns to 100 tons, we keep catches at 10 tons each. Let’s record everyone’s agreement before fishing and share our catch totals and donation receipts afterward.

Kate, will you join us on those terms? Then Emma can confirm.
